root.label: CBS report on Cornell Title IX transcripts

events.label: CBS report on Cornell Title IX transcripts

slots.name: transcript pages
slots.sentence: The 565 pages of transcripts were obtained by CBS News New York from a source.

slots.name: Title IX interviews
slots.sentence: A Title IX investigation was also conducted by Cornell in 2025, during which about 50 interviews were conducted with 32 witnesses.

slots.name: Title IX witnesses
slots.sentence: A Title IX investigation was also conducted by Cornell in 2025, during which about 50 interviews were conducted with 32 witnesses.

slots.name: rape certainty percentage
slots.sentence: But CBS News obtained a transcript of Jane Doe’s interview with campus police in which she said she was “100 percent certain” she was raped.

slots.name: victim age
slots.sentence: The woman, who was 20 years old at the time and has been identified only as Jane Doe, was interviewed over two days by campus police in mid-November 2024, about three weeks after the alleged incident occurred.

slots.name: statement length
slots.sentence: The interview was used as the basis for a six-page statement that was then provided to Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten, who told CBS News this week that he was never provided the full transcripts of that interview.

slots.name: police interview date
slots.sentence: In the room during the two-day interview on Nov. 14, 2024, was a Cornell police investigator who led the questioning, along with a Title IX investigator, a victim advocate and a personal adviser to Jane Doe.
